therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Antioxidant response activation and phase II detoxification enzyme induction
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Prevention of lung cancer progression by modulating cellular proliferation and apoptosis in bronchial epithelium
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Former smokers at high risk for lung cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in bronchial dysplasia index, Ki-67 proliferation marker, TUNEL apoptosis marker, and Caspase-3 apoptosis marker at 12 months

results.effect_size: Bronchial dysplasia index mean difference 0.22 (95% CI: 0.03-0.41), p=0.452; Ki-67 proliferation showed significant differences in some intensity categories (p=0.014, 0.028, 0.004)
biomarker_changes: Ki-67 proliferation marker showed decrease in sulforaphane group (-5.27) vs increase in placebo group (18.03) for all positive nuclei
Significant gene expression changes in nasal brushing samples for lung cancer risk genes (p=0.012, p=0.0045)
TUNEL and Caspase-3 apoptosis markers showed no significant differences between groups
subgroup_findings: Nasal brushing samples showed significant modulation of lung cancer risk genes with sulforaphane treatment
Bronchial brushing samples showed no significant gene expression changes
safety_signals: Grade 1 possibly related adverse events: 26 (sulforaphane) vs 12 (placebo)
Grade 2 possibly related adverse events: 3 (sulforaphane) vs 5 (placebo)
Overall safety profile similar between groups (p=0.590)
results.dose_information: 120 micromole sulforaphane daily oral dose for 12 months
